notes: A security release for the account side of GOAT; nothing changes in how you use it. Cloud backup, community sharing, satellite imagery and the AI coach now identify this PC on every call, so a copied config file no longer works from another machine, and the sign-in token is stored encrypted for your Windows account. If cloud backup ever says "device mismatch", sign out and back in from the Account panel. On the server: sign-ins are bound to the browser that started them, an unverified email can never claim an existing account, the free trial and loyalty months end exactly when they should, and a payment event that failed once is retried instead of dropped. Install this before 6 October: from that date the server requires the device check that only this version sends.
